note: Deduction keys (07, 8.6, ADR-203) used by the tax codes of the official list. A key is a named variable deduction rate of the VAT registration. The package creates the four keys, never a rate: rates are company input (inputs of package.json, core/vat_deduction_rate.json, or vat-deduction-rates:create-version later). A company that needs several sector or area keys or several estimate keys adds them itself. The core never computes a rate (19, A1)
